description.en: Annualized reported consolidated year-to-date sales. Acquisition timing and the mix of Starlink, launch and compute operations limit comparability with a normal trailing year.
description.zh: 对已报告的合并年初至今营收做年化处理。并购时点、星链、发射及算力业务组合影响其与普通滚动年度的可比性。

description.en: Uses the sum of Class A and Class B common shares on the latest filing cover. Future option and award dilution is outside the share count.
description.zh: 采用最新申报封面披露的 A 类和 B 类普通股合计；股数未计入未来期权和奖励稀释。

description.en: Current cash and marketable securities are added and reported debt plus finance leases are deducted at carrying value.
description.zh: 加计期末现金与可交易证券，按账面值扣除已披露债务与融资租赁。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Revenue growth and EV / revenue are research assumptions reflecting expected economics and risk. The equity bridge uses disclosed carrying values. The multiple is sensitive to future margins and funding requirements.
method_note.zh: 营收增速和企业价值／营收倍数是反映业务预期与风险的研究假设。由企业价值换算至股权价值时采用披露账面值。倍数对未来利润率与资金需求敏感。

rationale.en: Satellite capacity grows steadily while compute spending weighs on returns.
rationale.zh: 卫星产能稳步增长，算力支出拖累资本回报。

rationale.en: Starlink scales and contracted compute capacity converts into billable service.
rationale.zh: 星链扩大规模，已签约算力产能转化为可计费服务。

rationale.en: Satellite and infrastructure utilization rise faster than financing needs.
rationale.zh: 卫星与算力设施利用率提升快于融资需求。
